messages:
maya: quick follow-up from the KV-cache OOM postmortem — proposing a remediation plan and owners. main items: profiling runs, throttle/limits, GC tuning, fragmentation compaction probe. please ack or reassign by EOD Tue.

eric: ack. I'll own profiling + flamegraphs. ETA end of week. I have a profiling job template already.

sophia: I'll take GC/compaction experiments. plan to run on staging-only first and share perf numbers.

anya: I'll add automated alerted thresholds based on the new alloc curves and wire the alert to eng-runtime oncall.

david: I'll add JIRA tasks and link to the runbook. Can we decide tranche/priority? I'd prefer: profiling -> alerting -> GC experiments -> limits.

maya: sounds good. owners + rough ETA inlined:

- profiling: eric — spin runs by Fri 3/4
- alerts/limits: anya — PR by Wed
- GC/compaction experiments: sophia — POC next Monday
- JIRA + runbook: david — tickets + doc by Thu

eric: quick note: profiling should include long-tail traces (seq len 2048) and the new kv-snapshot flag. command:
```
run-profiling --workload=kv-heavy --seq=2048 --kv-snapshot
```
Include heap profiles and per-segment allocs.

sophia: for compaction, I'll test two knobs: 'frag_gc_max' and 'alloc_slab_size'. I'll also try a background compaction pass throttled during high QPS.

anya: alert thresholds — propose 3 staged alerts:
1) 70% of kv memory cap (warning)
2) 85% (paging/eviction rule trigger)
3) 95% (paging + oncall)
I'll open a PR with alert rules and playbook snippets.

maya: also recurring incident pattern: we see spikes Tue/Thu ~14:00 UTC correlated with a nightly batch job. Can eng-sre look into rerouting or rate-limiting that job?

eric: noted. I'll add a sampling trace on that job and annotate the timeline.

david: created tickets: INF-7421 (profiling), INF-7422 (alerts), INF-7423 (GC experiments), INF-7424 (runbook). links: https://jira.redwood/INF-7421 https://jira.redwood/INF-7422 https://jira.redwood/INF-7423 https://jira.redwood/INF-7424

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Staging GC-experiment job started by sophia at 1789504700

maya: next checkin Friday 11:00 PT. please update the jira and drop one-line updates in this thread before then. If any owner can't meet ETA, ping me ASAP. :thumbsup:

eric: ack
sophia: ack
anya: ack

eric: small question — are we comfortable with 3% mem overhead for profiling containers? we might bump cpu to keep latency low.
maya: yes, budget 3-5% for profiling, adjust if we see impact.

sophia: quick early result: enabling compaction showed ~18% drop in fragmentation after 2 hours in initial staging run. will share graphs in INF-7423.
